faq.general.q2: Where can I buy an Eastel SIM card?
faq.general.a2: Buy an Eastel physical SIM through our order page. Choose SIM only or add an available plan, enter your delivery details and review the final charges before paying.
faq.general.q3: How much does an Eastel SIM cost?
faq.general.a3: The displayed SIM price is for the physical card. Optional plan purchasing assistance and courier fees are listed separately. Review your selected items and final total before paying.
faq.general.q4: Is buying a SIM the same as subscribing to a monthly plan?
faq.general.a4: A physical SIM and a mobile plan are separate items. Choose SIM only or add a plan at checkout; its fee is listed separately. After receiving and registering your SIM, contact us to arrange the plan recorded in your order. The selected plan is a one-time charge and does not renew automatically.
faq.getting-started.q1: How do I register and activate my SIM?
faq.getting-started.a1: After receiving your SIM, follow the registration and identity-verification steps in the Eastel App. If your order includes a plan, contact us after registration to check its fulfillment before buying the same plan again.
faq.getting-started.q2: Can I keep my existing phone number?
faq.getting-started.a2: Yes. Eastel supports mobile number portability (MNP). Choose Port In during registration and follow the instructions. Approval and timing depend on both networks.
faq.getting-started.q3: Which mobile network does Eastel use?
faq.getting-started.a3: Eastel uses U Mobile network infrastructure. Coverage and reception depend on your location, device and surroundings. Contact us if you need help checking suitability.
faq.getting-started.a4: Eastel supports 5G on compatible devices with an eligible plan and 5G coverage. Check your device and selected plan before ordering, and contact us if you need help.
faq.support.q1: How can I track an order or get help?
faq.support.a1: Sign in to view your own orders, or use the order lookup form with the required reference and phone number. The order records the selected SIM, any plan fee and fulfillment status. Contact purchase support privately for delivery or plan-assistance questions.
faq.support.q2: Where in Malaysia can you deliver?
faq.support.a2: The order form supports postcode-based delivery zones for West Malaysia, East Malaysia and Labuan. Available couriers and charges appear after entering your postcode; contact us if the postcode is not recognised.
faq.support.q3: Where can I confirm coverage and international roaming?
faq.support.a3: Browse our roaming page for destinations, passes, data allowances and validity. Confirm your travel destination and plan eligibility before departure; contact us if you need help. A SIM order does not automatically include a roaming pass.
delivery.title: SIM delivery and purchase support | eastel.site
delivery.heading: SIM delivery and purchase support
delivery.desc: The order form checks your Malaysian postcode and offers the available couriers for West Malaysia, East Malaysia or Labuan. The SIM fee and delivery fee are displayed separately before payment. If your postcode is not recognised, contact us before placing an order.
delivery.section1.heading: Delivery areas and charges
delivery.section1.body: The order form checks your Malaysian postcode and offers the available couriers for West Malaysia, East Malaysia or Labuan. The SIM fee and delivery fee are displayed separately before payment. If your postcode is not recognised, contact us before placing an order.
delivery.section2.heading: Dispatch and tracking
delivery.section2.body: View your own order status and tracking information in your customer account. Delivery depends on the selected courier, destination and operating conditions. Contact us for a current estimate; no fixed delivery deadline is promised here.
delivery.section3.heading: Returns, damage and missing deliveries
delivery.section3.body: Contact support@eastel.site about an incorrect, damaged or missing SIM, a cancellation or a return request. Include your order reference through a private channel. Confirm return eligibility and any costs with us before returning an item.
delivery.section4.heading: Purchase help
delivery.section4.body: For questions about your SIM, selected plan or delivery, contact us privately with your order reference. SIM registration does not automatically create a shipping refund.
terms.title: Physical SIM purchase information | eastel.site
terms.heading: Physical SIM purchase information
terms.desc: Review SIM purchases, optional selected plans, separate charges, payment, delivery and registration steps.
terms.section1.heading: What you are buying
terms.section1.body: Choose SIM only or SIM plus an available plan at checkout. The selected items and fees are recorded separately in your order. Browsing information or receiving a recommendation does not place an order.
terms.section2.heading: Price and payment
terms.section2.body: Review the SIM fee, selected plan fee, courier fee, discount and final total before paying through ToyyibPay. After the required SIM registration, we manually arrange any plan included in your order. Payment confirmation and plan fulfillment are separate order statuses.
terms.section3.heading: Delivery and purchase support
terms.section3.body: Provide accurate contact and delivery details. For delivery, cancellation or return questions, contact us and read the delivery information. Do not post your order or payment details publicly.
terms.section4.heading: SIM registration and selected plans
terms.section4.body: Register your SIM in the Eastel App after delivery. If you purchased a plan, contact us after registration to confirm its fulfillment. The selected plan fee is charged once and does not renew automatically. Our FAQ explains activation and number porting.
privacy.title: Website order privacy information | eastel.site
privacy.heading: Website order privacy information
privacy.desc: Checkout requests your name, email, telephone and delivery address to process a SIM purchase. Customer accounts hold your profile and order history. The site records payment references and delivery details needed to follow up an order.
privacy.section1.heading: Website information
privacy.section1.body: Checkout requests your name, email, phone and delivery address to process a purchase. Order records include the SIM, optional selected plan, fees, fulfillment and payment references. AI-assisted filling is optional; a customer may instead enter these details on the website.
privacy.section2.heading: Processing and service providers
privacy.section2.body: AI-assisted details supplied with your authorization are encrypted in a private checkout-link fragment and expire after 15 minutes. Anyone holding a valid link may recover its details, so do not share it publicly. The website removes the fragment after reading it. Email, CAPTCHA, payment and delivery use the existing service providers.
privacy.section3.heading: Analytics and security
privacy.section3.body: Public-page analytics may use Google Analytics 4 when enabled; staging analytics are disabled. Cloudflare provides security and traffic protection. Do not put checkout fragments, customer details, tokens or payment references in public analytics links or reports.
privacy.section4.heading: Your data requests
privacy.section4.body: Contact support@eastel.site to request access, correction or deletion of your website order or account information. Requests require identity verification and remain subject to applicable record-keeping requirements.
